purpose: UI design reference, not runtime screenshots
basePrompt: Use case: ui-mockup. Design a high fidelity desktop browser interface for an original Chinese OnlineCOC Stumpsville tabletop adventure. Art direction based on the observed official Mausritter paper character sheet and Stumpsville preview: warm almost-white paper, charcoal ink, graphite hatching, hand-drawn small woodland mice, angular clipped-corner rectangular cards, precise black rules, compact serif Chinese headings with very legible Chinese sans body. Restrained moss green for primary actions, rust red for danger; neutral light backgrounds. Illustration supports usable UI. Flat front-on screenshot with no device mockup, no perspective, no photographic desk, no watermark. Large 16:10 landscape artboard, fine typography and generous spacing. All game values are sample data. Use the page/subUI IDs provided as small captions. Chinese text should be short and correctly written. The original book artwork is visual reference only: draw fresh illustrations rather than reproducing the original map. Maintain the same design language across this set. Navigation is a compact left rail, central main content, optional right contextual panel. Header shows 树桩镇 / STUMPSVILLE and current identity. Avoid huge ornamental fantasy frames, gradients, heavy drop shadows or generic colorful SaaS cards.
